summary.text: Clay Riley is a Republican member of the West Virginia House of Delegates for District 72, where he has served since 2020, and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. He is an engineer who owns The Thrasher Group.

paragraphs.text: Clay Riley earned two engineering degrees from West Virginia University.
His career experience includes working as an engineer and owning The Thrasher Group.
Riley has served in the House of Delegates since 2020 and advanced from the Republican primary on May 12, 2026.
